class Author

        def __new__(cls) -> Author.Core
    class Extension(Author)
        def __new__(cls, name: str) -> Author.Extension
        property name: str
    class Frontend(Author)
        def __new__(cls, client: str) -> Author.Frontend
        property client: str
    class Provider(Author)
        def __new__(cls) -> Author.Provider
    class Tools(Author)
        def __new__(cls) -> Author.Tools
class Body
    class Assistant(Body)
        def __new__(
            cls,
            parts: Sequence[Part],

            meta: str | None = None,
        ) -> Body.Assistant

        property meta: str | None
        property parts: list[Part]
        property stop: Stop
    class Config(Body)
        def __new__(cls, config: Config) -> Body.Config
        property config: Config
    class Custom(Body)
        def __new__(cls, kind: str, data: str) -> Body.Custom
        property data: str
        property kind: str
    class Results(Body)
        def __new__(cls, outcomes: Sequence[tuple[str, Outcome, Author]]) -> Body.Results
        property outcomes: list[tuple[str, Outcome, Author]]

    property images: list[Image]

== clients: Writing a frontend
class Client(AsyncIterator[Event], Protocol)
    async def abort(self, cursor: int) -> None
    async def answer(self, question: int, value: object) -> None
    async def children(self, id: int) -> list[int]
    async def close(self) -> None
    async def close_cursor(self, cursor: int) -> None
    async def commands(self) -> tuple[Form, ...]
    async def complete(self, cursor: int, named: str, prefix: str) -> list[Completion]
    async def complete_line(self, cursor: int, line: str) -> list[Completion]
    async def configure(
        self,
        cursor: int,
        extension: str,
        values: Mapping[str, object],
        *,
        save: bool = False,
    ) -> None
    async def go_to(self, cursor: int, to: int) -> None
    id: str
    async def image(self, sha256: str) -> str
    async def input(self, cursor: int, text: str, images: Sequence[ImageInput] = ()) -> int
    async def node(self, id: int) -> Node
    async def nodes(self, start: int, limit: int) -> list[Node]
    async def open(self, at: int) -> int
    async def options(self, cursor: int, extension: str) -> Form
    async def parse_line(self, cursor: int, line: str) -> Parsed
    async def remove_item(self, cursor: int, item: int) -> None
    async def remove_label(self, label: str) -> None
    async def reopen(self, cursor: int) -> int
    async def run(self, cursor: int, command: str, args: Mapping[str, object]) -> str | None
    async def send(self, cursor: int, text: str, images: Sequence[ImageInput] = ()) -> int
    async def set_auto(self, cursor: int, on: bool) -> None
    async def set_label(self, cursor: int, label: str) -> None
    async def step(self, cursor: int) -> None
    async def walk(self, id: int) -> list[Node]
    async def watch(self, cursors: Collection[int]) -> None

== machine: The step machine
class Answer
    class CallDone(Answer)
        def __new__(cls, call: str, outcome: Outcome, by: Author) -> Answer.CallDone
        property by: Author
        property call: str
        property outcome: Outcome
    class HookFailed(Answer)
        def __new__(cls, error: str) -> Answer.HookFailed
        property error: str
    class Hooks(Answer)
        def __new__(
            cls,
            stop: str | None = None,
            draft: Draft | None = None,
            halted_by: str | None = None,
        ) -> Answer.Hooks
        property draft: Draft | None
        property halted_by: str | None
        property stop: str | None
    class Sampled(Answer)
        def __new__(cls, parts: Sequence[Part], end: SampleEnd) -> Answer.Sampled
        property end: SampleEnd
        property parts: list[Part]
class Ending
    class Aborted(Ending)
        def __new__(cls) -> Ending.Aborted
    class Done(Ending)
        def __new__(cls) -> Ending.Done
    class Failed(Ending)
        def __new__(cls, error: str) -> Ending.Failed
        property error: str
    class Halted(Ending)
        def __new__(cls, reason: str) -> Ending.Halted
        property reason: str
class Hook
    PostReply: ClassVar[Hook]
    PostResult: ClassVar[Hook]
    PostStep: ClassVar[Hook]
    PreInput: ClassVar[Hook]
    PreReply: ClassVar[Hook]
    PreSample: ClassVar[Hook]
    PreStep: ClassVar[Hook]
    property name: str
class Job
    class Hooks(Job)
        def __new__(
            cls,
            point: Hook,
            draft: Draft | None,
            node: int | None,
            ending: Ending | None,
        ) -> Job.Hooks
        property draft: Draft | None
        property ending: Ending | None
        property node: int | None
        property point: Hook
    class Pending(Job)
        def __new__(cls) -> Job.Pending
    class Rest(Job)
        def __new__(cls) -> Job.Rest
    class RunCalls(Job)
        def __new__(cls, node: int, calls: Sequence[RunCall]) -> Job.RunCalls
        property calls: list[RunCall]
        property node: int
    class Sample(Job)
        def __new__(cls) -> Job.Sample
class Next
    RunTools: ClassVar[Next]
    Sample: ClassVar[Next]
    Wait: ClassVar[Next]
class RunCall
    property args_raw: str
    property id: str
    property tool: str
class SampleEnd
    class Cancelled(SampleEnd)
        def __new__(cls) -> SampleEnd.Cancelled
    class Failed(SampleEnd)
        def __new__(cls, error: str, meta: str | None = None) -> SampleEnd.Failed
        property error: str
        property meta: str | None
    class Finished(SampleEnd)
        def __new__(
            cls,
            stop: Stop,
            reason: str | None = None,
            meta: str | None = None,
        ) -> SampleEnd.Finished
        property meta: str | None
        property reason: str | None
        property stop: Stop
class Session
    def abort(self, cursor: int) -> bool
    def add_item(self, to: int, data: ItemData) -> int
    def answer(self, cursor: int, answer: Answer, now: int) -> None
    def append(
        self,
        parent: int,
        body: Body,
        by: Author,
        now: int,
        copied_from: int | None = None,
        derived_from: int | None = None,
    ) -> int
    def append_root(self, config: Config, by: Author, now: int) -> int
    def close(self) -> None
    def close_cursor(self, cursor: int) -> None
    def closed(self) -> list[tuple[int, int]]
    @staticmethod
    def create(
        config: Config,
        system: str,
        now: int,
        directory: str | PathLike[str] | None = None,
    ) -> Session
    def cursor(self, cursor: int) -> CursorState
    def cursors(self) -> list[int]
    def fork(self, node: int, now: int, directory: str | PathLike[str] | None = None) -> Session
    def go_to(self, cursor: int, to: int, client: str, now: int) -> bool
    def hook_move(self, cursor: int, to: int, by: Author, now: int) -> None
    def hook_set_auto(self, cursor: int, on: bool) -> None
    def hook_write(
        self,
        cursor: int,
        body: Body,
        delivers: Sequence[int],
        by: Author,
        now: int,
        copied_from: int | None = None,
        derived_from: int | None = None,
    ) -> int
    def input(self, cursor: int, by: Author, text: str, images: Sequence[Image] = ...) -> int
    def label(self, label: str) -> int
    def labels(self) -> list[tuple[str, int]]
    @staticmethod
    def load(directory: str | PathLike[str]) -> Session
    def next_job(self, cursor: int) -> Job
    def open(self, at: int, by: Author, now: int) -> int
    @staticmethod
    def read(directory: str | PathLike[str]) -> Session
    def remove_item(self, id: int) -> None
    def remove_label(self, label: str) -> None
    def send(self, cursor: int, by: Author, text: str, images: Sequence[Image] = ...) -> int
    def set_auto(self, cursor: int, on: bool) -> None
    def set_label(self, label: str, cursor: int) -> None
    def step(self, cursor: int, command: bool = False) -> None
    def take_notices(self) -> list[tuple[str, int, str | None, str]]
    property tree: Tree

== tokenizers: Tokenizers
# tau_tokens
class ChatTemplate
    def __new__(cls, source: str, tokens: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> ChatTemplate
    @staticmethod
    def from_config(config: bytes, source: str | None = None) -> ChatTemplate
    def render(
        self,
        messages: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
        tools: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
        *,
        add_generation_prompt: bool = True,
        extra: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        now: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> str
class IdentityError(ValueError)
class TemplateError(ValueError)
class Tokenizer
    def count(self, text: str) -> int
    def encode(self, text: str) -> list[int]
    @staticmethod
    def from_json(data: bytes) -> Tokenizer
    @staticmethod
    def tiktoken(name: str) -> Tokenizer
    property vocab_size: int
    def work(self) -> tuple[int, int]
class TokenizerError(ValueError)
__version__ = version('ffwf-tau-tokens')

def catalogue() -> list[dict[str, Any]]

def verdict(pairs: Sequence[tuple[str, int, int]]) -> Literal['candidate', 'confirmed', 'dropped']
